description: Erection of a part single storey rear extension following demolition of the conservatory and erection of part first floor rear extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 1133/01, 1133/02, 1133/03, 1133/04, 1133/05, 1133/06A, 1133/10A, 1133/06A (Fire Safety), Unnumbered Block Plan (Fire Safety), Unnumbered Location Plan, Heritage, Design, and Access Statement Received 23 February 2023; 1133/07B, 1133/08B, 1133/09B Received 04 April 2023

Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good for the retained fabric, shall match the original work in type, colour, texture, profile and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, including facebond and pointing.
Condition : 4 - The windows to be fitted on the roof faces of the extensions shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
